# Apex Development Studio LLC

> Veteran-owned independent software studio in Aldie, Virginia (Northern Virginia). Designs and ships native iOS and Android apps and mission-driven websites. Founded by Joe McMullin, a veteran with 22 years of military service and nearly two decades in enterprise and federal IT.

## Services
- iOS, iPadOS and macOS apps: Swift, SwiftUI, HealthKit, CloudKit, StoreKit 2
- Android apps: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Health Connect, Play Billing
- Websites for mission-driven organizations: research, brand, copy, build and hosting

## Pages
- [Services](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/services/): how every project runs, from discovery and a security plan before design through launch and support.
- [iOS app development](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/services/ios-app-development/): native SwiftUI apps for iPhone, iPad and Mac.
- [Android app development](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/services/android-app-development/): native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose apps.
- [Web development](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/services/web-development/): websites for mission-driven organizations.
- [Journey Tracker case study](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/work/journey-tracker/): how the app was built and taken through App Review.
- [About](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/about/): founder biography.
- [Start a project](https://apexdevelopmentstudio.com/start/): four-step project intake form.

## Work
- [Journey Tracker](https://journeytracker.app): GLP-1 therapy and weight-loss companion for iPhone, iPad and Mac; live on the App Store. Health data stays on the user's devices and their own iCloud.
- [Gleaming Beacon](https://gleamingbeacon.com): personal life-alignment app for iOS and Android, coming soon. All charts are computed on the device.
- [HINA — Humanitarian Initiative for Native Advancement](https://hinapacific.org): client website, built end to end.
